title: BSAE: spike-to-spike compression with delay-tolerant training

architecture.block: Time-distributed Linear followed by recurrent LIF
architecture.adapter: Platform-specific input adapter, followed by the channel-validity mask; there is no decoder adapter
architecture.shared: The encoder and decoder are shared across platforms
architecture.temporalAxis: All stages preserve sequence length; tapering denotes schematic channel compression, not time downsampling or exact geometric scale

training.target: The original canonical spike sequence before adaptation
training.padding: Input and target receive 30 zero-tail bins in the current configuration
training.delay: A single shared bank of learned per-channel softmax distributions over d=0,...,30; causal delay of the TARGET only. It is not an input-conditioned predictor or a decoder layer.
training.softDelay: An event at t contributes at t+d with learned weight p_c(d)
training.filters: Apply the same 20-bin exponential kernel to delayed target and reconstruction with full convolution
training.objective: Mean squared difference across batch, all 1024 channels and full filtered time axis

representations.spikeRasters: Editable schematic marks, selected illustrative channels only, not recorded/model-produced samples
representations.widths: Encoder/decoder tapering is schematic; exact dimension sequences must be visible
representations.asset: One generated abstract neural-recording pictogram, independent and illustrative, with no semantic labels or connectors inside its pixels
representations.math: Use native grouped text for X, Z, reconstructed X with a separately positioned hat, p_c(d) and L_VR when present; no raster formulas

relationshipPlan.main: Spikes are compressed in channel dimension and reconstructed while the time axis is preserved.
relationshipPlan.branch: The loss uses the ORIGINAL target through a learned causal delay bank and the reconstruction through an undelayed branch; both then receive the same exponential filter.
relationshipPlan.scope: Panel b reuses explicitly labeled target and reconstruction from panel a; diagram does not assert skip connections, time compression or measured performance.
relationshipPlan.endpoint: Connectors meet visible native frames or native rectangular funnel ports coincident with the visible funnel boundary.
relationshipPlan.delayInset: If a worked distribution is shown, use an explicit illustrative three-tap kernel [0.2,0.5,0.3] at delays 0,1,2; remaining delays are zero in the example. The learned bank still permits 0 through 30.

reference.observation: Inspected for scale-changing encoder/decoder representations and dimension annotation. Do not transfer U-Net skip links or spatial-resolution semantics to BSAE.

visibleEdgeMapping: encoder-in/out and decoder-in/out are visible rectangular end ports coincident with their tapered module boundaries. loss-target-port and loss-output-port lie on the left boundary of the single loss module.
